configuration.preprocessing: train median + missing flag, fixed 16 genres, unweighted train standardization, remove constant columns
configuration.rank_tolerance: float64 eps * max(original training rows, selected columns) * largest singular value
configuration.scope: retrospective frozen-release cohort generalization, not an as-of forecast
configuration.selection: mean equal-fold baseline-relative MSE skill; then fewer variables; then lexicographic predictors
configuration.test_isolation: pilot uses only pre-2018 songs; campaign final test reserved until all winners frozen
configuration.uncertainty: 500 song-cluster resamples of fixed final predictions; additional two-year debut-block intervals when at least three blocks exist; no selection/refit inside bootstrap
configuration.weights: inverse rows per song within target-observed partition, normalized to mean 1
